title: Advances in Package Microvia Interconnects: Breakthroughs With Picosecond UV Laser Ablation
venue: IEEE TCPMT, vol. 15, no. 11, pp. 2531-2538, Nov. 2025
orgs: 3-D Systems Packaging Research Center, Georgia Institute of Technology; JSR Corporation; Center for Heterogeneous Integration of Micro Electronic Systems, Pennsylvania State University
notes: 5 ps 355 nm laser percussion microvias through sputtered Cu barrier: 1.26 um in 2 um JSR GT-N01, 5 um pitch, 0.24 um mean landing error; ABF GX92P filler blockage study.

title: High-Density Integration of III-V Devices and EICs using Vertical-Coupled Photonic Packages with Glass-IP and Redistribution Layers
notes: Concept Glass-IP OOI/NPO package (EML/PD flip-chip, backside EICs via TGVs, prism+lens optics) simulated; only a single-channel EML-on-Glass-IP prototype measured (89 GHz, 106.25 Gbaud PAM4).

title: Direct Glass-Copper Vias Integrated with Blind-Cavity Embedded Chips using Nanoscale Liner
orgs: Georgia Institute of Technology; Thin Film Technology Corporation
notes: MOSFET in fs-laser blind cavity of 320 um glass, DAF + 30 um ABF, backside blind vias with ~200 nm SiOxNy liner, Ti/Cu seed, DC vs reverse-pulse Cu fill; 100 thermal shock cycles.
